scope: Replacement MP4 players in the evidence chapter
method: Observed Chromium browser playback via supported computer-use API, using local preview with HTTP byte-range support.
checks: Both video streams load with duration12seconds and dimensions1200x676, readyState4 and no media error
Both videos play to their12second end and show different first/final scenes
Native scrubbers seek both clips to about6.11seconds and pause there
Both clips resume after seeking and replay from the beginning
No console warning or error observed
Visible controls, direct open/download links, poster images and descriptions are present
preview_note: An initial basic Python HTTP preview did not support byte ranges, limiting seekable ranges to0. The media-capable local preview returned range responses, after which both complete0to12second ranges and native seeking were verified. Normal offline playback needs no server.
limits: Actual presentation computer and native PowerPoint playback not tested.
Browser verification used localhost because the automation browser restricts direct file URLs.
